question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which ex-Spartan do you want to see more of?
Are you excited for the next season?

nodes.text: They push on the door, but it doesn't budge...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's some debris wedged against the door! Everybody, push!
The door begins to give way and then...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Procedure?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, in the event of an emergency, we're all supposed to head through the school quietly and calmly in an orderly manner until we reach the front.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Procedure smocedure, bro!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: You mean, `bro`cedure? Anyone? Anyone?
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, [color=#e23b3b][i]bro[/i][/color]cedure? Anyone? Anyone?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: The roof of the library is gone! I think quietly, calmly, and orderly just got demolished in the `earthquake!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The roof of the library is gone! I think quietly, calmly, and orderly just got demolished in the [color=#e23b3b][i]earthquake![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's `still` an emergency! I know you guys are all new here, but if you violate procedure at this school, you could suffer some serious consequences!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#e23b3b][i]still[/i][/color] an emergency! I know you guys are all new here, but if you violate procedure at this school, you could suffer some serious consequences!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Hey, guys, I'm Ben! Do you all have your emergency nerd handbooks? We have to follow them blindly, or we'll get in trouble!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't sound like that.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: You do, dude. You really do! Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Wait... If we do end up ditching, I bet Ben here will snitch on us!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: And if he snitches on us, we'll probably have to talk to... To Ms. Lee...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Awww, man, that woman is crazier than my aunt, and she plays bingo with her cat!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Fine... Let's just do what Nerdbook says!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My name's not Nerdbook!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: It is now. Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hope you're okay, Jessica... Wherever you are, hang on! I'm coming!
Chad leads them through the debris toward the front door of the library...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Jessica? Oh, man, that's right! I keep forgetting that you're actually `dating` that hot blonde!
nodes.text_bbcode: Jessica? Oh, man, that's right! I keep forgetting that you're actually [color=#e23b3b][i]dating[/i][/color] that hot blonde!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: I'm sorry, dawg, but there's no reason `we` have to go help you save `your` hot cheerleader girlfriend!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry, dawg, but there's no reason [color=#e23b3b][i]we[/i][/color] have to go help you save [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] hot cheerleader girlfriend!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... But she does have hot, `single,` cheerleader friends!
nodes.text_bbcode: No... But she does have hot, [color=#e23b3b][i]single,[/i][/color] cheerleader friends!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: He's right! Maybe they're all hurt!
Ben glares at him...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What? `Lightly` hurt.
nodes.text_bbcode: What? [color=#e23b3b][i]Lightly[/i][/color] hurt.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: That'd be awesome! We could be heroes! I'll be like all, 'Let me sweep you off your feet, girl, cause I'm a broom and you're my dustpan.'
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whatever works, I guess... Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hope you're okay, Jessica... Wherever you are, hang on! I'm coming!
Ben leads the Spartans through the debris toward the front door of the library...
A weak voice calls out from nearby...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait, guys! Do you hear that?
They listen...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: It sounds like a dude!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Help me find him!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine... We'll go out the back. I don't want to get caught in an aftershock any more than you guys do...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You've finally come to your senses!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, but it feels wrong in my stomach...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Bro, that's probably just all the library dust you've swallowed!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh-huh...
The guys head toward the back exit of the library...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not leaving the school! Not when people could still be hurt!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: It's your funeral then! Come on, Mark!
Chad and Mark head toward the back exit of the library...
Ben leaps from dry patch to dry patch until he's on the other side of the water spill...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nothing to it!
The Spartans follow behind him until each one of them is safely on the other side with Ben.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Made it!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: That wasn't so hard...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Kazam! Eat it, professional gymnasts!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... There aren't any gymnasts watching this, Mark. It's not like we're on TV.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Don't rain on the Backbutter parade.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not a sentence I ever expected to hear...
Ben starts to head back into the photo lab but the fire flares up, the heat pushing him back!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not messing with this fire anymore! It's too dangerous!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's okay... They're just pictures...
For a second, the two of them watch as the fire consumes the photo lab...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Just pictures...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry...
The fire reaches the wall nearest to them and begins to eat through, spreading into the hallway!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on! We've got to get out of here!
Ben and Nick crawl through the smoke toward the entrance!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We're there!
On the school's front steps, a huge crowd of students is huddled together, all of them fraught with worry...
Among them, is Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben?! Ben, where are you?!
Another aftershock strikes!
The ground rises up in a rolling wave, the building's foundation makes a low groaning sound, and cracks run through the walls at the school's entrance!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no! Not now!
A steel beam falls through the ceiling panels above Ben and Nick, slamming into the tile floor! A mountain of rubble follows, blocking them from the entrance!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What do we do?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We can crawl through that gap in the rubble there! You go first!
Ben helps Nick through the gap. He turns back to Ben...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm through! Come on...
As Ben crawls toward the gap, he hears a hoarse voice calling to him from behind...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ben... `Cough!` Ben, get over here and help me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ben... [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough![/i][/color] Ben, get over here and help me!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ben? Are you coming?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, go on, Nick! I'm right behind you!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You sure?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah! Go!
Nick turns and runs out, vanishing behind the blanket-thick smoke...
Outside, Nick emerges from the building!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick! You're okay?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, I am. Over-smoked, but okay...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Where's Ben?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: He was right behind me...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He was?! Oh no!
Jessica marches up the steps of the school and stands at the edge of the school's entrance, unable to see inside...
Ben looks back to Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's Denni, she's in trouble!
Jessica's strained voice punctures through the smoke...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben... If you don't come out of there right this second...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm... I'm going to be really `really` mad!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm... I'm going to be really [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] mad!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Do you hear me?
Time slows down for Ben...
Down the hall, he can make out the orange flickering of the fire, spreading out, coming closer...
He can see the desperation in Colt's soot-framed eyes...
He can hear the worry in Jessica's voice...
And then, he is filled with clarity...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Do you... Do you hear me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, Jess! I hear you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm okay, but stay out there!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What's going on?
Ben looks at Colt...
Ben runs back into the photo lab, the fire now raging! He can hear the walls creaking...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Hot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hot![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He grabs the USB drive, turns, and sprints out, just as part of the ceiling comes crashing down!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I got it, Nick! Here!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks... That was both heroic and stupid.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm beginning to think they're kind of the same thing...
Ben rushes into the photo lab! The fire is now burning all around him! On a nearby counter, flames lick at Nick's camera!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There it is!
Ben grabs it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whooo! That's hot!
He tosses it back and forth in his hands as he bursts out of the lab!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I got it!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks, Ben. But seriously, you didn't have to do that!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is that it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well... There's a picture I took of Sam on our first date... It's on a USB drive near the door!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But it's okay, Ben! You don't have to go after it!
Ben heads back into the photo lab!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Cough! Cough!` So much smoke!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough! Cough![/i][/color] So much smoke!

nodes.text: He grabs a bunch of photos hanging on a wire above his head!
He emerges from the lab and drops them into the box...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's good, Ben... `Cough!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's good, Ben... [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is there anything else of value to you in there?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: My camera, but...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where is it?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: On the counter on the left!
Ben and Nick rush back into the photo lab where the fire has spread to the walls!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's getting hot!
Ben grabs another stack of photos...
And drops them into the box!
Ben and the Spartans get in position to push on the door... On the inside, Spencer wraps his hand around the handle...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ready! One, two, three... Go!
Ben and the Spartans collectively shove on the door just as Spencer gives it a tremendous yank... The door pops open!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Apologized? For what?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: For cheating in the Spartan Games...
Ben raps on the door with his knuckles...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spence... If they apologized for cheating in the Spartan Games, would you let them save you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't know... What about the test scores?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Our scores didn't affect you!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh really? The money you got `could` have gone to us!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh really? The money you got [color=#e23b3b][i]could[/i][/color] have gone to us!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I heard you guys bought lockers made out of gold from all that SET money! Our lockers have the same value as cardboard!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Touche.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Guys, I know Spencer. He's about as stubborn as they come... But he's usually stubborn for good reason...
Carson sighs...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I never really felt right about how Percy had us cheating on the SETs, even if it did get us money...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I'm still getting used to a lunch menu `without` Spartan Lobster Tots...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm still getting used to a lunch menu [color=#e23b3b][i]without[/i][/color] Spartan Lobster Tots...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Nevertheless, I apologize, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yeah, man, whatever gets us out of here faster! I apologize!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Chad?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I'm not apologizing!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Listen, Chad, this would be a pretty progressive step in mending things between our schools!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not only would it be a reasonably nice gesture, considering that you `did` cheat on those tests and you `did` cheat in the Spartan Games, but you'd also get to `save` someone.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not only would it be a reasonably nice gesture, considering that you [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] cheat on those tests and you [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] cheat in the Spartan Games, but you'd also get to [color=#e23b3b][i]save[/i][/color] someone.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Fine! Fine! Fine! I apologize. For the test scores and the stupid Spartan Games!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Now, can we finally save this guy?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. Get me outta here!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Haha! Sick! I'll be Bark Mackbutter, billionaire spy, night time crime fighter, and all-the-time ladies man!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You'll be Erik, the nerd we just encountered.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Aww, major downgrade!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Carson, you're Hector. And Chad, you're Ryan! Got it?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah... Let's get this over with...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Spence? I got rid of those dumb Spartans.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Don't push it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ahem... I managed to find Erik, Hector, and Ryan...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why would those guys be together?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's an earthquake, big guy. Things aren't exactly normal out here. Anyway, you ready?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait... I don't hear them...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... They're right here...
Ben elbows Mark...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Uh, I just finished plugging in my science monitor! Hot boy, I love... Science.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Boom! He just said that! Now let's get this aftershock afterparty rolling!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Also, have any of you guys seen my girl? I miss Mando-Orlando!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Uh... What's going on? Where are all the chicks?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That sounds about right. Let's get this door open!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Remind me why we're following you again!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Seriously... Who appointed this guy leader?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I didn't, that's for sure!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: We should have gone out the back of the library when we had the chance! Now it's too late! We're stuck with you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sorry, guys, but we're closer to the front now... Let's just get there...
Ben leaps onto a dry patch...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: See? It's not that hard.
He takes another leap, landing on a wet tile!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Whoop!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Whoop![/i][/color]

nodes.text: His leg gives out from under him, and he is flung into the air, crashing down onto the floor with a splash!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Ha! That looked pretty `hard!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! That looked pretty [color=#e23b3b][i]hard![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Shut up, Mark!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: We're not going to go this way... We're going to find a different route!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! We're not splitting up!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: What other alternative do we have?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine... You guys can... Can use me as a stepping stone...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Ha ha! Awesome! Let's step on Ben!
The Spartan guys delight in leaping across the slick patch by using Ben as a stepping stone.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Thanks, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You didn't have to jump so hard on me!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I'll admit... That was more fun than I thought it would be...
As the group proceeds through the smoke, Ben nods at a familiar door...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on, guys. That's Ms. Prez's classroom. That means we're about halfway to the front of the school!
They push forward until they reach a demolished drinking fountain. Water pours out onto the slick floor from a busted pipe...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: That's a broken arm just waiting to happen...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: It's a slippery trap, man! We should just find another way!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, guys, you made it through a grueling, multi-day paintball battle royale! It's just water! All you have to do is step on all the dry patches! I'll show you!
Ben grabs Chad, stopping him!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What are you doing?!
Just then, a huge machine on a cart thunders past them...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Whoa! That would have hurt!
A second later, Erik follows, chasing the cart!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No one was monitoring the monitors! It's the rise of the machines! Save yourselves!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Should we be concerned?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: About a machine uprising, no. About Erik, maybe.
Ben does nothing. Chad takes another few steps...
And a huge machine on a cart slams into him, knocking him over!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: `Yow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yow![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you okay?!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I just got flattened by a machine! What do you think?!
Erik arrives, out of breath...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I sure am glad you were there to stop the seismic activity monitor from crashing into a wall! Thanks, Chad!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Machines, right? They can predict earthquakes, but they just can't steer themselves!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Unless we programmed them to...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ho boy... The future sure is the scariest time!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Right. I'm gonna go now...
Erik hefts the machine back onto the cart and runs off with it. Ben picks Chad up off the floor...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Glad to see you're here to help me `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Glad to see you're here to help me [color=#e23b3b][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, Chad... I should have warned you...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on, the smoke's getting thicker! We've gotta keep moving!
The group comes to an intersection of hallways... As they step into the center... They hear...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No brakes! No brakes! Runaway seismic activity monitor!
Ben hears the sound of wheels rolling down the hall...
But Chad's slow to react...
The Spartans get out of the way just in time!
Jacob flies by!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Slow down, Jacob! You're going to hurt someone!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Sorry! Are you guys all right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... We're fine.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Have you seen Maria?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... No, we haven't...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Okay, thanks... You're sure you guys are okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, we're all right. Go find Maria...
Jacob turns the corner, this time a little bit more cautious...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I thought that guy hated us...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think, in a crisis, petty differences don't matter anymore...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! I mean... Watch out!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Aaahhhh!
Jacob collides with the Spartans, all of them falling down together in a massive heap!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What's the matter with you?!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What's the matter with us?! What's the matter with you?!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yeah! You ran into us on purpose!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Why would I do something so stupid?!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Because you don't like us... And because you `are` stupid!
nodes.text_bbcode: Because you don't like us... And because you [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] stupid!

nodes.text: Jacob grabs Carson by the collar and cocks his fist back for a punch!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa, Jacob!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Give me one good reason not to, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How about `we just had an earthquake?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: How about [color=#e23b3b][i]we just had an earthquake?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jacob lowers his fist...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now why were you running so fast?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Maria... Have you seen her?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... We haven't...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Okay... Sorry... Just... Sorry...
Jacob scrambles to his feet and runs off, disappearing around the corner...
Ben does nothing, watching wide-eyed as the silhouette nears!
Ben closes his eyes, hoping they'll avoid him...
But Zach slams into Ben, knocking him over!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Watch out! We're trying to get Lee to the hospital!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What happened? Is he okay?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: There's no time for talking! Now move!
Ben gets out of the way, and the football players disappear in the thickening smoke...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What's wrong with you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I thought they'd go around me...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: They didn't, man! They ran right over you! You got `so` owned! That was awesome!
nodes.text_bbcode: They didn't, man! They ran right over you! You got [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] owned! That was awesome!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Not now, Mark. Didn't you see? Lee's hurt. This is serious.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Oh... Yeah... Sorry...
As Ben rises to his feet he sees a silhouette in the fog rushing toward the cluster of Spartans!
Ben throws himself out of the path of the players! The Spartans follow suit!
The football players rush by...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Coming through!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Fast reflexes, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks!
The stampede of football players disappears in the thickening smoke...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What did he mean by 'man down'?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: You didn't see?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I had my back turned.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: They were carrying Lee...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no... I hope he's okay...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Me too...
Just then Ben sees a silhouette in the fog rushing toward the cluster of Spartans!
They topple into the hallway! As they get to their feet, Ben takes in his surroundings...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh my...
All around them is complete and utter chaos...
Water gushes from a broken pipe, students run wildly through the halls, and smoke billows in from somewhere unknown...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Cough cough!` Let's go! Everyone, this way! Stay low!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough cough![/i][/color] Let's go! Everyone, this way! Stay low!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I can't see a thing!
Ben leads the Spartans down the smoke-filled hall toward the front of the school...
Suddenly, footsteps pound from behind as a squad of football players rounds the corner and barrels toward them!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Outta the way! We've got a man down!

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let's keep moving...
The group presses on.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How's everyone doing?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where are you, Jessica?
Just then, Ben hears a voice calling from the restroom...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale? Is that you? Help me out! I'm stuck in here!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spence?!
Ben tries to push the door open, but it doesn't budge.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't get the door open! Is something blocking it?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No! I think the quake messed up the door! I can't get it open!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine... You pull, and I'll push! Ready?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: One, two, three... Go!
Ben pushes as Spencer pulls, but the door is still stuck.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We need more manpower! Come on, guys!
The Spartans step up to the door...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait... Who's with you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, Chad, Carson, and Mark.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Spartans?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Ex`-Spartans, yeah.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ex[/i][/color]-Spartans, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Go find someone else!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: They're cheats! They cheated to get good test scores, and they cheated in the Spartan Games!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not going to have those guys save me! If they do, I'll owe them! And I don't want to owe `them` anything!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not going to have those guys save me! If they do, I'll owe them! And I don't want to owe [color=#e23b3b][i]them[/i][/color] anything!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer, you don't have a choice! It's chaos out here! There's no one else!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not going to pull if they're the ones pushing!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Let's just leave him!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yeah! He doesn't even want to be saved, man! He's in the restroom! He's got everything he needs for survival in there, anyway!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What exactly do you think is in there? It's a restroom, Mark, not a grocery store!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: All I'm saying is... I could last.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, what if you guys...
The fire reaches the wall nearest to them and begins to eat through, spreading into the hallway!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on! We've got to get out of here!
Ben and Nick crawl through the smoke toward the entrance!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We're there!
On the school's front steps, a huge crowd of students is huddled together, all of them fraught with worry...
Among them, is Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben?! Ben, where are you?!
Another aftershock strikes!
The ground rises up in a rolling wave, the building's foundation makes a low groaning sound, and cracks run through the walls at the school's entrance!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no! Not now!
A steel beam falls through the ceiling panels above Ben and Nick, slamming into the tile floor! A mountain of rubble follows, blocking them from the entrance!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What do we do?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We can crawl through that gap in the rubble there! You go first!
Ben helps Nick through the gap. He turns back to Ben...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm through! Come on...
As Ben crawls toward the gap, he hears a hoarse voice calling to him from behind...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ben... `Cough!` Ben, get over here and help me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ben... [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough![/i][/color] Ben, get over here and help me!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ben? Are you coming?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, go on, Nick! I'm right behind you!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You sure?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah! Go!
Nick turns and runs out, vanishing behind the blanket-thick smoke...
Outside, Nick emerges from the building!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick! You're okay?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, I am. Over-smoked, but okay...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Where's Ben?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: He was right behind me...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He was?! Oh no!
Jessica marches up the steps of the school and stands at the edge of the school's entrance, unable to see inside...
Ben looks back to Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's Denni, she's in trouble!
Jessica's strained voice punctures through the smoke...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben... If you don't come out of there right this second...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm... I'm going to be really `really` mad!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm... I'm going to be really [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] mad!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Do you hear me?
Time slows down for Ben...
Down the hall, he can make out the orange flickering of the fire, spreading out, coming closer...
He can see the desperation in Colt's soot-framed eyes...
He can hear the worry in Jessica's voice...
And then, he is filled with clarity...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Do you... Do you hear me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, Jess! I hear you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm okay, but stay out there!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What's going on?
Ben looks at Colt...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I have to help Colt save Denni!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben, the school's not safe! The whole thing could collapse at any moment!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know! That's why I have to go `now...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I know! That's why I have to go [color=#e23b3b][i]now...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I love you, Jess.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben! You don't know what you're doing! Listen to me and get out here this instant!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I `am` listening to you, Jess. I'm just not `obeying` you.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] listening to you, Jess. I'm just not [color=#e23b3b][i]obeying[/i][/color] you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What is that supposed to mean?!
Ben turns around...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben? Ben?! `Ben?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ben? Ben?! [color=#3b78e2][i]Ben?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He crawls to Colt...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let's get Denni out of here!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Follow me!
Ben and Colt crawl into the classroom...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Cough! Cough!` I got most of the wall pieces off her, but... But...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough! Cough![/i][/color] I got most of the wall pieces off her, but... But...

nodes.text: Ben gasps when he sees Denni... She's lying awkwardly, her leg splayed out at an unnatural angle...
And pinned by a massive concrete boulder!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I just couldn't lift it...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Denni...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Denni...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Denni's eyes open weakly, and she turns her head toward Ben...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Just couldn't get enough of me, could you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. Let's, uh, let's get this off of you...
Ben and Colt stand on either side of the boulder...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ready?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ready...
They heave with all of their might, but the boulder doesn't budge...
Out in the hall, another section of the school roof collapses!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This is `not` happening!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] happening!

nodes.text: Colt throws his whole body against the boulder, every ounce of his strength concentrated on moving it...
But it still doesn't budge!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've got an idea...
Ben crawls back into the hallway and retrieves the steel beam that had fallen just a minute earlier...
He returns...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What are you thinking?! We're not going to be able to break it, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's not why I brought it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Archimedes said, 'Give me a lever long enough, and I shall move the world.'

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't care what some dead Greek guy said! Just do whatever it is you're going to do!
Ben shoves one end of the beam underneath the boulder and puts his weight on the exposed end...
The boulder begins to lift!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Son of a...
Colt runs over and adds his weight to the beam...
The boulder lifts up...
And rolls off of Denni, its great mass slamming onto the floor with a loud `thud!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And rolls off of Denni, its great mass slamming onto the floor with a loud [b]thud![/b]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Ow! Ow! Ow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ow! Ow! Ow![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How do we get her out of here?
A few tense seconds later... Ben and Colt emerge from the school, Denni's arms around each of their shoulders!
Rescue workers help them away from the building...
Just as the walls of the school entrance collapse behind them!
The sun begins to set, and the students of Twin Branches look on as firemen put out the flames that were ravaging the school...
Among the students are a range of emotions...
`Gratitude...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Gratitude...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hey, Ben, uh, Mark just wanted to say thanks for getting us out of there...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Mark` wanted to say that?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Mark[/i][/color] wanted to say that?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah. What a sap!
`Relief...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Relief...[/b]

nodes.text: Jacob holds Maria in his arms while she cries...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I was so scared. I didn't know where you were...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: `Sniffle!` Well, you found me now!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sniffle![/i][/color] Well, you found me now!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Heh. I'm not letting go anytime soon.
`And worry...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]And worry...[/b]

nodes.text: In the parking lot, Colt brings his motorcycle up to Ben...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She got taken to Centerscore County Hospital. See you there?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I heard Lee's there, too...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She's okay, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's just her leg. She's tough.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The toughest.
Colt starts to drive off, but stops himself...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I, uh, I know it's a weird time to bring this up... But I accepted that Friend Invite you sent me on Faceplace...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Faceplace?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Your girlfriend told me that might mean something to you...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Figured it was the least I could do, you know, after...
Ben notices Jessica looking at him from across the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Anyway, see you there.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm right behind you...
As Colt speeds off, Ben holds Jessica's gaze. The feeling between them is a mix of all those emotions and more...
Among them, a fragile, desperate grasp of love.
Finally, Ben breaks his gaze, gets inside his car, and heads to the hospital...
That was intense! You helped Ben save the ex-Spartans, rescue $ZOE, Howard, Sam, Nick (and his photos), and did the right thing by helping Colt save Denni!
In short, you transformed Ben into a real life hero! You played a great game!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, Colt... You heard her... I have to go...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What?! You're going to abandon Denni?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't have a choice, Colt! This entire place is going to come down at any moment!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can't believe this! Go on then! Save yourself!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Watch me!
Ben turns and crawls away, heading out of the school...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben! Ohmygosh! I was totes worried!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I'm... I'm okay now.
A few minutes later, Colt and Denni emerge from the school, Colt cradling Denni in his arms!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We need an ambulance!
Several of the football players help out, placing Denni in a nearby ambulance. It speeds off toward the hospital...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So, it looks like you didn't need me after all...
Colt wheels on Ben, punching him in the face! Ben drops immediately!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She could have died, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I told you, I didn't have a choice!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Abandoning her `was` a choice! If you've learned anything at this school, you should have at least learned that your choices have consequences!
nodes.text_bbcode: Abandoning her [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] a choice! If you've learned anything at this school, you should have at least learned that your choices have consequences!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I hope you're ready to live with this one!
Jessica comes to Ben's side...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He's wrong, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, he's not. He's completely right.
Weeks later, Ben walks down the newly rebuilt hallway... But all he sees are looks of scorn.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What is everyone mad about?
Nearby, Erik drops a copy of the school paper on the ground...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can't read anymore! Scandals give me heart palpitations!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Scandal?
Ben picks up the paper and looks at the headline...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no! Denni's latest article is a recap of the events of the earthquake!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Everyone knows what I did!
Just then, Denni hobbles around the corner on a pair of crutches.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni, wait...
She limps past him, not even giving him the slightest glance...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Denni...` I'm sorry...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Denni...[/i][/color] I'm sorry...

nodes.text: Well, that was heavy! It also wasn't the outcome Ben wanted!
Play again, and see if you can get a more heroic ending!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You guys can't leave `now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You guys can't leave [color=#e23b3b][i]now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Ben's right, Chad!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: I knew I should have listened to my inner voice, man. I knew it was wrong to leave...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Shut up, Mark. A second ago, your inner voice was pretty vocal about being aftershock bait!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, how about both of you shut up so we can find him?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Fine! We'll help this `one` stupid guy, but that's it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine! We'll help this [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] stupid guy, but that's it!

nodes.text: They head in the direction of the voice, toward an overturned bookcase...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's someone under here! Come on... Lift!
The guys lift the bookcase off, and a figure rises up out of a pile of books...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Oof... That's what I call some heavy reading...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Carson? You're the stupid guy?!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I wasn't expecting such a literal case of adding insult to injury, but yeah, it's me. Nice to see you too.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Injury? You're hurt?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: No, not really. I'm okay. Just a sore chest...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Chad wanted to leave you, man.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: So did you, Mark!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Guys, let's just be happy we found Carson and that he's okay... Help me look for other people...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: There isn't anyone else! We need to get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You didn't think `Carson` was here, and he was. We should `check!` Unless you're okay with leaving another Spartan behind...
nodes.text_bbcode: You didn't think [color=#e23b3b][i]Carson[/i][/color] was here, and he was. We should [color=#e23b3b][i]check![/i][/color] Unless you're okay with leaving another Spartan behind...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Fine...
After a few minutes of searching, Ben and the Spartans don't find anyone else...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess that's it. Wow, `nobody` uses the library anymore!
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess that's it. Wow, [color=#e23b3b][i]nobody[/i][/color] uses the library anymore!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Ha! Newsflash! Welcome to ten years ago!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I told you we wouldn't find anyone! Now let's go!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: If we go the back way, we can hit the parking lot and get out of here! No school!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: As nice as it'd be to escape... I know from the text Jessica sent before the earthquake that she's somewhere the other way! And I'm pretty sure Carson isn't the only one who's going to need our help...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We should go through the building, toward the school's entrance!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Whoa! `Through` the building? That's like a hundred miles away!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! [color=#e23b3b][i]Through[/i][/color] the building? That's like a hundred miles away!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: We'll be aftershock bait for sure!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Why don't we just head out the back like I said before?! We've already got Carson!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Yeah, we've already got me. And seriously, once you've got me, who else do you need?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Guys, we have to go through the school because...

nodes.text: I thought we were leaving!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That was before we knew someone was in trouble! We can't just abandon him!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yeah, that's, like, not cool!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Shut up, Mark. You were right behind me.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Whatever, man. Maybe I was looking for people where `you` happened to be.

nodes.text: Spartans?! What?! You lied to me, Kale?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was for your own good! I had to save you somehow!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This is just the kind of thing I was trying to warn you about earlier!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I told you, man. One of these days, Jessica's going to make you do something you shouldn't do!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: She's rubbing off on you, man! Before her, you never would have lied to me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's an earthquake! I was just trying to get you out! Jessica didn't have anything to do with this!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you sure about that, Kale?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whatever... This isn't the time to discuss this!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm sure later won't be either!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just come with us...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine, but don't expect me to thank you.
A little while later, Ben, Spencer, and the Spartans turn a corner, and the school entrance comes into view!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Finally! Daylight!
As they head toward it, Ben sees the photo lab out of the corner of his eye...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I talked with Howard, $ZOE, Nick, and Sam in there before the earthquake...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sure they got out, but I should probably check anyway!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, guys, the entrance is right there. You go on ahead!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: { See ya, wouldn't want to... {

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Shut `up,` Mark!
nodes.text_bbcode: Shut [color=#e23b3b][i]up,[/i][/color] Mark!

nodes.text: The Spartans keep on heading toward the entrance, but Spencer stops.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Where are you going, Kale? Are you crazy?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I have to check the photo lab!
Ben crouches underneath the smoke layer, and Spencer follows behind him... They crawl toward the lab...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If I die trying to save a bunch of photo stuff, your face is grass, Kale.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spoken like a true best friend. I'm not going for photo stuff, I'm going for Howard, $ZOE, Sam, and Nick.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Samface? She's in trouble?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know, but I have to make sure!
They reach the door... And hear voices inside!
Ben flings it open!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hello?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ben?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ben, we're trapped!

In the hospital, Ben knocks on the door of Denni's hospital room...
Ben!
Hey, Tweed, come on in.
I was just going to pick up some food for Princess here. You want something?
I'm good. Thanks.
Colt leaves, and Ben takes a seat at the edge of Denni's bed.
So... Uh...
What do the doctors say?
My leg's pretty busted. Turns out that legs aren't meant to be crushed under a mountain of concrete.
I'm sorry...
It's okay. They keep telling me it'll heal.
That's good news...
Denni takes a deep breath...
How about you, huh? Ben, my hero.
Heh. I think your hero just left to get you some food.
Maybe I'm lucky... Maybe I've got two heroes.
Or unlucky. I think most people don't actually need `one,` let alone two.
Yeah, I guess I'll have to swear off megalomaniacal jerks with access to helicopters and, you know, walls.
That second one's going to be tough...
Hee hee... I've missed this.
What?
Talking to you like this.
Yeah... You know, I'm... I'm not going to let that happen again.
Uh... You can't prevent an earthquake, Ben.
Heh. No... I mean, I'm not going to let our friendship disappear like it did.
We should be friends... And not just on Faceplace... Real life friends.
I couldn't agree more!
So, how's it going with Colt? He, uh, he seems to really care about you.
He does!
Also, based on our last talk, I think I'm apparently going to be doing a lot of `sneaking...`
Heh. That seems about right.
Hey, what about Lee? I heard he's in here too...
I was going to check on him after I checked on you...
What? Go see what's up with him and then let me know!
Heh. If you think I'm leaving you by yourself, you're crazy.
You `have` changed.
A little while later, Colt comes back with food, and Ben leaves to check on Lee...
Ben steps into Lee's room...
And catches him and Paige making out!
Whoa! Sorry!
Knock, ever?
It's all right, Paige. What's up, Ben?
I just wanted to make sure you were okay.
No complaints!
I'm alive, I'm with a girl I really like...
Awww...
And I'm a part of Twin Branches...
How could I not be okay?
Heh. That's an unusual perspective.
What do you mean?
Well, I just have this feeling that a lot's going to change now because of the earthquake...
I mean... I know `I` have...
I'm just wondering what else will.
It looks like Ben and Denni have patched up their friendship!

Previously on Surviving High School...
While tutoring the Spartans in the library, an earthquake shook the foundations of Twin Branches, burying Ben, Chad, and Mark in a pile of rubble!
And now...
In the darkened library, Ben coughs...

nodes.text: Where are you? What did you break?

nodes.text: My shades! My classic shades! They're all crooked now!

The lights flicker on... All around them is the destructive aftermath of the quake...
Toppled bookcases, crumbled walls, and above them, steel beams and dangling wires exposed by the collapse of the ceiling.

nodes.text: Oh man! We've gotta get out of here!

nodes.text: He's right! The Backbutters aren't supposed to die young!

nodes.text: You know that an aftershock is an earthquake and not a shark, right?
